Practicing my plots 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(p8105.datasets)
data("ny_noaa")
```

```{r}
noaa_ny_df = 
  ny_noaa |>  
  separate(date, into = c("year", "month", "day"), sep = "-") |> 
  mutate(
    year = as.numeric(year),
    prcp = as.numeric(prcp), 
    snow = as.numeric(snow),
    snwd = as.numeric(snwd), 
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax),
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin),
    tmax = tmax / 10, 
    tmin = tmin / 10, 
    prcp = prcp / 10
    ) |> 
  filter(
    !is.na(tmax), 
    !is.na(tmin)) 
```

#scatter

```{r}
noaa_ny_df |>
  filter(prcp > 100 | prcp < 500) |> 
  filter(year == 2000) |> 
  mutate(
    text_label = str_c("ID: ", id, "\nYear: ", year)) |>  
  plot_ly(
    x = ~tmin, y = ~tmax, type = "scatter", mode = "markers", 
    color = ~prcp, text = ~text_label, alpha = 0.5) 
```
Improve 

#box plot 

```{r}
noaa_ny_df |> 
  plot_ly(y = ~tmax, color = ~year, type = "box", colors = "viridis") 
```


# Line plot  

```{r}
noaa_ny_df |> 
  filter(snow < 1000) |> 
  group_by(year, snow) |> 
  summarize(
    avg_snow = mean(snow, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  plot_ly(x = ~year, y = ~avg_snow, type = "scatter", mode = "lines", colors = "viridis")
```

# bar chart

```{r}
noaa_ny_df |> 
  filter(snow < 1000) |> 
  group_by(year, snow) |> 
  summarize(
    avg_snow = mean(snow, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  plot_ly(x = ~year, y = ~avg_snow, type = "bar", color = ~year, colors = "viridis")
```
maybe this is counting the number of snow entries rather than amount?
